storylines.headline: Saturday finals: Oklahoma stuns No. 1 Texas; Georgia wins at Alabama
storylines.body: October 10, AP ranks from the October 4 poll: Oklahoma 27–24 over No. 1 Texas; No. 2 Georgia 20–17 at No. 6 Alabama; No. 21 UCLA 17–15 at No. 13 Oregon; Kentucky 35–34 over No. 10 LSU in overtime; South Carolina 38–19 at No. 16 Florida; North Carolina 21–17 at No. 25 Pittsburgh. All 46 Saturday FBS games are verified finals, checked October 11 against ESPN completed-game summaries and NCAA.com.

storylines.headline: Week 7: Ohio State at Indiana leads a 59-game FBS slate
storylines.body: Ohio State (5–1) visits unbeaten Indiana (6–0) at noon ET on FOX. Washington–Purdue moved to Friday, Oct. 16. Wisconsin at UCLA is 7:30 PM ET on NBC. Charlotte–Temple is 1 PM ET and Louisiana Tech–ULM 8 PM ET; Penn State–Michigan is on CBS. Nebraska–Oregon’s kickoff is still officially TBA.

storylines.headline: Saturday changes: Rice–ECU at 1 PM ET; Kansas–Utah at 8 PM ET
storylines.body: Rice at East Carolina moved to 1 PM ET on ESPN+ because of weather. Kansas at Utah moved to 6 PM MDT / 8 PM ET, with ESPN App coverage and the linear ESPN network still to be announced. Georgia Tech says its 3:30 PM ET game remains scheduled; weather has canceled several campus festivities. Follow the schools’ current advisories before traveling.

storylines.headline: Friday finals: Louisville, Iowa, Utah State, Wyoming and BYU win
storylines.body: October 9 results: Louisville 44–20 Florida State; Iowa 41–24 Washington; Utah State 17–16 Washington State; Wyoming 16–13 San José State (OT); BYU 24–10 Iowa State. Verified October 10 against ESPN completed-game summaries, quarter scores and official school reports. The Saturday slate has 46 FBS-vs-FBS games.

storylines.headline: Thursday finals: Liberty, Western Kentucky, UTSA and South Alabama win
storylines.body: Oct 8 results: Liberty 35, Sam Houston 3 (Liberty 5–1, 2–0 CUSA); Western Kentucky 34, Missouri State 13 (Western Kentucky 2–4, 1–1 CUSA); UTSA 31, South Florida 24 (UTSA 5–1, 2–0 AAC); South Alabama 56, Arkansas State 49 (on the road; South Alabama 4–2, 2–0 Sun Belt). Earlier in Week 6: Troy 55, Southern Miss 34 (Tue); Jacksonville State 27, Kennesaw State 26 (Wed, on the road); FIU 22, New Mexico State 3 (Wed). Scores and records per ESPN game pages, verified 2026-10-09 11:07 UTC; Conference USA and Sun Belt standings pages agree. The American's standings page had not posted UTSA–South Florida at check time.

storylines.headline: North Dakota State's first FBS season is 5–0 with the nation's co-lead in scoring defense
storylines.body: The Bison (5–0), tied for the FBS lead in scoring defense at 9.8 points allowed per game (NCAA, through Oct 3), receive votes in both polls (AP 7, Coaches 29). They visit UNLV on Saturday, Oct 10 — 7 PM ET on The CW.
